# AgendaWeb — Full LLM & Agent Technical Reference

> Complete technical documentation for AI agents, LLMs, and retrieval engines interacting with AgendaWeb.

## 1. Organization & Identity

- **Name:** AgendaWeb
- **Type:** Cultural Guide, Event Aggregator, and RSS Syndication Platform
- **Canonical Domain:** `https://agendaweb.app`
- **Contact:** `curator@agendaweb.app`
- **Publisher:** Claudinei Sousa (techsousa)
- **Content-Signal:** `search=yes, ai-train=no`

## 2. Structured Data & Schema.org Implementation

AgendaWeb publishes Schema.org JSON-LD structured data on all primary pages:
- **Homepage:** Implements `Organization`, `WebSite`, `WebApplication`, and `ItemList` nodes.
- **Venues Page:** Implements `ItemList` of `LocalBusiness` / `MusicVenue` nodes.
- **Events:** Individual events provide Schema.org `MusicEvent` / `Event` nodes with `startDate`, `endDate`, `location` (`Place`), `offers`, and `image`.

## 3. Machine-Readable REST APIs

All REST endpoints return `application/json; charset=utf-8` and support CORS headers.

### GET /api/events.php
Query upcoming live music and cultural events.

#### Query Parameters:
- `category` (string, default: `all`): Filter by category (e.g. `Live Music`, `Culture`, `Community`).
- `city` (string, default: `all`): Australian metropolitan slug (`melbourne`, `sydney`, `brisbane`, `perth`, `adelaide`, `hobart`).
- `venue` (string, default: `all`): Venue slug (e.g. `the-corner-hotel`, `the-night-cat`, `bar-oussou`).
- `age` (string, default: `all`): Audience restriction filter (`18+`, `all_ages`, `kids_family`, `unrated`).
- `family` (boolean, default: `false`): Restrict to family-friendly verified events.
- `limit` (integer, default: 50, max: 100): Page limit.
- `offset` (integer, default: 0): Result offset for pagination.

#### Sample JSON Response:
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "count": 42,
  "city": "melbourne",
  "categories": ["All", "Live Music", "Culture"],
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 104,
      "venue_slug": "bar-oussou",
      "venue_name": "Bar Oussou",
      "title": "Sunday Sunset Afro-Beat Session",
      "description": "Live jazz and afrobeat ensemble performance.",
      "category": "Live Music",
      "age_restriction": "18+",
      "start_time": "2026-11-22 18:30:00",
      "end_time": null,
      "address": "659 Sydney Rd, Brunswick VIC 3056",
      "suburb": "Brunswick",
      "ticket_url": "https://events.baroussou.com.au",
      "image_url": "https://agendaweb.app/assets/poster.jpg"
    }
  ]
}
```

### GET /calendar.php
RFC 5545 iCalendar stream.
- Parameter: `venue=all` (or specific venue slug).
- Header: `Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8`.

### GET /feed.php
RSS 2.0 / Atom syndication feed.
- Parameter: `venue=slug` (optional).
- Header: `Content-Type: application/rss+xml; charset=utf-8`.

## 4. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Card

AgendaWeb serves a SEP-1649 MCP Server Card at:
`https://agendaweb.app/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json`

The JSON-RPC endpoint is hosted at `https://agendaweb.app/api/mcp.php`.

Supported MCP Tools:
1. `get_events`: Retrieve upcoming live concerts and cultural exhibitions.
2. `get_venues`: Retrieve independent venues directory and addresses.
3. `export_calendar`: Get calendar URL for event scheduling.

## 5. WebMCP In-Browser Agent Tools

When loaded in an agentic web browser supporting `navigator.modelContext`, AgendaWeb registers:
- `search_events`: Real-time gig search directly through the in-page client layer.
- `get_venue_details`: Venue lookup.
- `get_cultural_channels`: Syndication feed inquiry.

## 6. Content Negotiation: Markdown

Requesting `Accept: text/markdown` or `Accept: text/plain` on the homepage (`/`) or `/index.html` returns a markdown document.
